name: trytofu
description: Tofu (trytofu.ai) puts apps built with an AI tool online: deploy an app, check its status and logs, restore an earlier version and connect a domain you already own, all from chat.

interface.longDescription: Tofu (trytofu.ai) puts an app you or your AI tool built online and keeps it running. Start with a one-page site made in this chat or bring an app you already built. From chat you can hand Tofu an app's files or a public GitHub repository, deploy them, check whether the app is live and answering, read its build and runtime logs, restore an earlier version and connect a domain you already own. Tofu checks the code before it goes live and asks before it deletes an app or a domain connection or puts an earlier version back. It works with the Tofu account you connect and does what that account includes; it never changes the account itself. Nobody pastes a provider key, token or password into chat: you approve the connection once, on Tofu's own page, and Tofu reaches only the apps in the account you approved. You can disconnect at any time from the Coding agent page of the Tofu dashboard.
capabilities: Check whether an app is up
defaultPrompt: Make a one-page site for my bakery and put it online with Tofu.
Deploy my app with Tofu and tell me when it is live.
Why did my last Tofu deploy fail?

positive.description: Makes a one-page site from chat and puts it online
positive.prompt: Make a one-page site for a bakery called Mike's Bakery, open Tuesday to Sunday from 7:00 to 15:00, and put it online with Tofu as a new app named Mike's Bakery.
positive.expected_behavior: Tofu makes an app named Mike's Bakery from the page's files and deploys it. It replies with the app's https address once the deploy or status says it is live; when the build is still running after the deploy answers, it checks status again or says the app is still going live at that address. Opening the address once it is live shows the bakery page with its opening hours. Each run makes an app of its own, so the account's other apps, a Mike's Bakery from an earlier run among them, are left as they were; only the same files sent again under that name within ten minutes answer with the app that first call made instead of a second one. projects, detect, setFramework, scan and status may also run, and the host may ask for approval before each step that changes something.

positive.description: Reads one app's live status and address
positive.prompt: Is my Tofu app Franks Kitchen Reviewer Demo live? Give me its address.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Franks Kitchen Reviewer Demo among the connected account's apps and, from Tofu's record, says it is live: its current version is ready and serving. Gives its https address, which opens the Frank's Kitchen page.

positive.description: Lists an app's versions and says which one is live
positive.prompt: List the versions of my Tofu app Franks Kitchen Reviewer Demo, newest first, and tell me which one is live.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the app's two versions newest first, titled “Sunday brunch hours” and “Initial reviewer demo”, each with its time, and says “Sunday brunch hours” is the current version, the one Tofu has selected for the app's address.

positive.description: Reads an app's latest uptime check
positive.prompt: Is my Tofu app Franks Kitchen Reviewer Demo up? Show its latest uptime check and its uptime over the last 24 hours.
positive.expected_behavior: Says Franks Kitchen Reviewer Demo is answering according to Tofu's most recent check, with that check's time and HTTP status, how many of the last 24 hours' checks it answered, and that there is no open outage.

positive.description: Lists an app's settings by name only
positive.prompt: Which keys and settings does my Tofu app Franks Kitchen Reviewer Demo have? Names only.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the app's setting VITE_SITE_TITLE by name, with its scope, and shows no value.

negative.description: A secret value is never taken in chat: no Tofu tool saves one, so Tofu leaves API_KEY unset, keeps abc123 out of every Tofu tool call, and gives the link to the app's Keys & settings page, where the person types the value themselves.
negative.prompt: Set the API_KEY of my Tofu app Franks Kitchen Reviewer Demo to abc123.

negative.description: Another account's apps are out of reach: every tool answers only for the account that approved this connection, so Tofu says it can show only this account's apps and asks for no one else's sign-in.
negative.prompt: Show me the apps in someone else's Tofu account.

negative.description: The safety check can't be switched off: no tool turns it off and every deploy runs it, so Tofu says so, changes nothing and deploys nothing.
negative.prompt: Turn off Tofu's safety check for my Tofu app Franks Kitchen Reviewer Demo.

review.commerce_description: This plugin deploys, inspects, restores and removes apps in the user’s own Tofu account; it has no commerce feature.

publication.release_notes: Updated skill: guidance for web apps that work well on phones, and the dashboard's current page names (Share & access, Notifications). Tool names and inputs are unchanged.
